title: Agent 技能生态开始补基础设施
opening: 今天榜单几乎被 Agent 技能包和配套工具占满：从 AG-UI 把 Agent 输出标准化成事件流，到 NVIDIA 给技能做质量评估，再到 Plannotator 补上人类审阅层。最值得先看的是 AG-UI 1.0 冻结规范，以及 last30days 用真实互动数据做搜索的取巧思路。

projects.name: ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui
projects.description: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
projects.readmeExcerpt: The open protocol that connects any agent to any app. **Docs** · **Examples** · **Spec** · **Discord** **AG-UI is an open, lightweight, event-based protocol that standardizes how AI agents connect to user-facing applications.** Agents don't fit the request/response model. They stream tokens, call tools mid-response, update shared state, pause for a human, and spawn subagents, and every framework does it differently. AG-UI replaces that custom wiring with one bi-directional event stream: the agent emits typed events, and any client can render them, no matter which framework built the agent. The same agent can power a web app, a mobile app, a terminal, or Slack. > [!IMPORTANT] > **AG-UI 1.0 is here.** The protocol now has a stable, frozen specification backed by a JSON Schema, and the TypeScript, Python, and .NET SDKs are generated from it. 1.0 is backwards compatible in both directions: 0.x agents work with 1.0 clients and vice versa. What changed → · Migration guide → Quick start **Start a new app.** The CLI scaffolds a frontend (CopilotKit on Next.js, or a terminal client) wired to the agent framework you pick: Then follow the printed next steps. The generated templates call OpenA
projects.summary: 把 Agent 的流式输出、工具调用、状态更新统一成双向事件流，让前端不用为每个框架重写接线。
projects.problem: Agent 不是请求-响应模型，它会中途调工具、暂停等人、派生子 Agent，各家框架事件格式又不同。AG-UI 用一份 JSON Schema 生成 TypeScript、Python、.NET SDK，1.0 还保证与 0.x 双向兼容，适合想一次接入多框架 Agent 的前端团队。

projects.name: tradermonty/claude-trading-skills
projects.description: Claude Code skills for equity investors and traders — market analysis, technical charting, economic calendars, screeners, and trading strategy development.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Claude Trading Skills **Data handling:** Privacy policy · Security policy Claude Trading Skills started as a personal project to use AI to improve my own trading process. Claude Trading Skills is a Claude Skills-based trading workflow toolkit for time-constrained individual investors. It is designed for investors who use long-term investing, ETFs, and dividend stocks as their core, while using disciplined swing trading as a satellite strategy when market conditions are favorable. The goal is not to outsource buy/sell decisions to AI. The goal is to structure market review, risk management, trade planning, journaling, and continuous improvement. It is open source because the workflows, checklists, and review habits behind better trading decisions can improve through shared practice. This is not a signal service or a promise of profitability. It is a toolkit for traders who want to build a better decision process. The project follows a **first for self, open for others** stance: it is built first as a practical workflow the author uses, then shared openly for others who face similar constraints. 📖 **Documentation site:** **Project vision:** `PROJECT_VISION.md` 日本語版READMEは`README.ja.
projects.summary: 给个人投资者的一套 Claude 技能，把市场复盘、风控、交易计划和日志变成可重复的流程。

closing: Agent 技能从“堆数量”进入“建标准、做评估、补审阅”的阶段，今天这几个项目正好各占一环，值得按这个顺序看一遍。
